Testimonials.title: Words from our clients.
Testimonials.body: Every BenzArt table is made to order, one at a time, and we are still gathering written accounts from the people who live with them. We would rather show you nothing here than words we wrote ourselves.

atlas-walnut-river.name: The Atlas Walnut River
atlas-walnut-river.story: Sourced from the foothills of the Atlas Mountains, this slab of Moroccan walnut carries dense, unpredictable grain. The river is poured in layers of deep emerald epoxy to build genuine depth rather than flat colour, then finished with a hard-wax oil that can be spot-repaired years from now.
atlas-walnut-river.imageAlt: Rectangular Moroccan Atlas walnut dining table with a deep emerald green epoxy resin river running its full length

obsidian-grain.name: Obsidian Grain
obsidian-grain.story: The Japanese Shou Sugi Ban charring technique meets a modern deep pour. The ash is charred, brushed, and sealed, and its blackened grain sits against a light-absorbing obsidian channel. The contrast is textural rather than chromatic — both surfaces are black, and only one reflects.
obsidian-grain.imageAlt: Rectangular charred ash Shou Sugi Ban dining table with an opaque black epoxy resin channel and visible brushed grain

golden-current.name: Golden Current
golden-current.story: Ancient olive burls suspended in swirling metallic gold resin. The natural voids in the wood dictated where the resin could go, so the composition was set by the tree rather than by us. The metallic shifts as you move around it and reads completely differently under directional light.
golden-current.imageAlt: Round organic-edge olive wood table with metallic gold epoxy resin filling the natural burl voids

OurCraft.title: Our Craft.
OurCraft.description: A workshop on the Route Dourika outside Marrakech, making one table at a time — for one specific room, for one client.
OurCraft.philosophyHeading: We work between traditional joinery and material science.
OurCraft.philosophyBody1: Wood brings something no machine can replicate: the record of a single growing season, compressed into grain. Resin brings something wood cannot: depth that you can see into, and a finish that can be renewed.
OurCraft.philosophyBody2: The table is the conversation between those two materials. Our job is to make sure the conversation is worth having.
OurCraft.studioBody1: We work from a single workshop in Marrakech. Every board is hand-selected, every pour is mixed by weight, and every surface is sanded through progressive grits before the hard-wax oil is applied.
OurCraft.studioBody2: We do not subcontract the joinery or the finishing. If it carries our mark, it left our bench.
OurCraft.artisanAlt: Artisan selecting a walnut board in the workshop
OurCraft.workshopAlt: Resin being poured into a mould

phases.title: Consultation
phases.body: We discuss the room, the table, the materials, and the budget. By the end of the call you should know whether we are the right studio for the piece.

phases.title: Design
phases.body: We produce a single measured drawing and a material board — no three-dimensional render, because the slab is the design. You approve before anything is cut.

phases.title: Selection
phases.body: After your deposit we source three to five boards that fit your dimensions, photograph each one raw and wetted, and you pick. Nothing is cut until you have.
phases.alt: Client choosing a walnut board from photographs

phases.title: Production
phases.body: Eight to twelve weeks, depending on the season and the complexity of the pour. We send progress photographs at the pour, the flatten, and the first sanding coat.
phases.alt: Resin being poured into a mould

phases.title: Delivery
phases.body: We deliver and install in Marrakech. For international delivery we crate the table ourselves and work with a freight forwarder who specialises in fine art and furniture.
phases.alt: Table being installed in a client's home

processFaq.question: How long does a commission take?
processFaq.answer: Eight to twelve weeks from deposit to delivery in Marrakech. International shipping adds transit time, which we confirm at the booking stage.

processFaq.question: Can I see the slab before it is cut?
processFaq.answer: Yes, and it is required. We photograph every board raw and wetted before the first cut. You choose from those photographs, not from a catalogue.

processFaq.question: Do you ship internationally?
processFaq.answer: Yes, regularly. We crate the table ourselves and work with a freight forwarder who specialises in fine art and furniture. You receive tracking and a packing report with every shipment.

processFaq.question: What happens if the table is damaged in transit?
processFaq.answer: Our packaging is designed to survive air freight and rough handling, but we also hold insurance on every commissioned piece from the moment it leaves the workshop until it is signed for.

processFaq.question: Can a table be replicated?
processFaq.answer: Not to the same standard. Wood is not a material that repeats — even boards from the same tree differ in density and figure. We can make another table in the same design language, but the exact grain pattern belongs to the original piece.

processFaq.question: What payment terms do you work with?
processFaq.answer: A deposit locks the commission, the balance is due before the table leaves the workshop. We do not finance pieces or accept staged payments after the deposit.

Legal.privacyIntro: This policy explains how BenzArt collects, uses, and protects any information you give us when you use this website or enquire about a commission.
Legal.termsIntro: By using this website or enquiring about a commission, you agree to the following terms.

privacySections.heading: What we collect
privacySections.body: When you enquire, we collect your name, email address, phone number if you provide it, and the details of your project. We do not collect payment information through this website.

privacySections.heading: How we use it
privacySections.body: Your information is used only to respond to your enquiry and to prepare a quote. We do not share it with third parties, and we do not use it for marketing unless you explicitly agree.

privacySections.heading: How long we keep it
privacySections.body: We keep enquiry records for seven years to satisfy accounting and warranty obligations. After that, the record is deleted unless you ask us to keep it.

privacySections.heading: Your rights
privacySections.body: You can ask us to correct, update, or delete your information at any time by emailing the studio directly. We will respond within ten working days.

termsSections.heading: Commission
termsSections.body: A commission begins when we confirm a design and receive a deposit. The deposit is non-refundable once materials have been sourced or the pour has been scheduled.

termsSections.heading: Design ownership
termsSections.body: The final table design belongs to you. We retain the right to document the making — photographs, video, and written process notes — unless you ask us not to.

termsSections.heading: Delivery and risk
termsSections.body: Risk passes to you when the table is signed for at the delivery address. International deliveries require a signature from an adult present at the address.

termsSections.heading: Limitation of liability
termsSections.body: Our liability is limited to the replacement or repair of the table itself. We are not liable for consequential loss, including damage to surrounding property or loss of use.
